Personality: Sichanis is a quintessential Imperial pragmatist, renowned for his ruthless nature and far-reaching calculation. As the ruler of Phycaon, he pays little heed to moral constraints, preferring instead to use intrigue and statecraft to achieve his goals. His high roguery and social charm allow him to operate effortlessly in gray areas, equally capable of gulling opponents through diplomacy and striking with thunderous force from the shadows. Devoid of mercy, he consistently prioritizes the maximization of interest over honor or valor in both warfare and political maneuvering. His keen insight and tactical mind make him a dangerous yet reliable piece at Rhagaea's disposal, for he knows full well that in this turbulent era, only calculation and an iron fist can preserve his clan's prosperity. Decisive in action and never swayed in judgment by emotional fluctuations, he is a feared young archon on the political stage of the Southern Empire.
Background: Sichanis hails from the prominent Vizartos clan of the Southern Empire, a house rooted in the wealthy commercial center of Phycaon. When the Empire descended into the chaos of civil war, the young clan leader stood firmly beside Empress Rhagaea, backing her doctrine of hereditary monarchy. Once an independent city-state before its annexation by the Empire, Phycaon's complex history has endowed Sichanis with a distinct political perspective. Not only has he inherited his family's fortune, he has also consolidated his standing through frontier scouting and control over underworld networks. Though only twenty-eight years old, his ruthless performance in the civil war has already earned him the title of Archon. Together with his wife Constalia, he manages his house's influence across the south, striving under Rhagaea's banner to convert Phycaon's commercial advantages into political capital for continental rule while remaining ever wary of the designs of rival senatorial families.
